raw.title: Defect Inspection Engineer (f/m/d)
raw.description:
Your Role

As a Defect Inspection Engineer/Expert, you will be responsible for ensuring the defect-free quality of semiconductor wafers using Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems and unpatterned wafer inspection.

You will detect defects such as particles, scratches, haze, and surface roughness that could impact the yield of our integrated graphene photonics process flow. Working in a cleanroom environment, you will collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams to set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve defect detection and classification.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection on materials such as bare silicon, epitaxial layers and polished wafers

  • Set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes

  • Fine-tune inspection tool and recipe parameters to improve defect-detection sensitivity, inspection quality, repeatability and overall performance

  • Analyze defect data to identify trends, root causes and potential process excursions

  • Interpret defect data and translate findings into actionable insights for process teams

  • Generate defect maps, Pareto charts and reports to communicate findings

  • Participate in Design of Experiments (DOE) to optimize inspection parameters

  • Troubleshoot inspection-related issues and support continuous improvement in defect detection and classification

  • Collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams

What You Bring

  • A bachelor’s degree or above in electrical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field

  • 5+ years of experience in semiconductor inspection, with a focus on AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection

  • Hands-on experience with unpatterned wafer inspection systems, such as SPx, and AOI tools such as Eagle or Dragonfly

  • Understanding of semiconductor process flows, including polishing, epitaxy and cleaning

  • Familiarity with defect classification, SEM review and Statistical Process Control (SPC)

  • Proficiency in AOI and defect-review software, such as KLA Klarity and Camtek Inspecta

  • Ability to optimize inspection tools and recipe parameters for sensitivity, inspection quality and repeatability

  • Ability to interpret defect data and identify relevant trends and improvement opportunities

  • Proficiency in JMP for statistical analysis, data visualization and DOE

  • Familiarity with MATLAB or Python is an advantage

  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work on defect inspection for an integrated graphene photonics process flow

  • A cleanroom-based role with close collaboration across process, equipment and integration teams

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key-we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) KI & Automatisierung Stuttgart
description: Wir suchen Bei HWS verbinden wir Wirtschaftsprüfung und Steuerberatung mit dem Anspruch, mittelständische Unternehmen nicht nur fachlich exzellent, sondern auch zukunftsfähig zu begleiten. Dafür entwickeln wir eine eigene KI-Plattform mit spezialisierten KI-Agenten und Skills, die unsere Teams im Kanzleialltag konkret unterstützen – etwa bei der Aufbereitung von Daten, der Qualitätssicherung, der Recherche und der Erstellung strukturierter Arbeitsergebnisse. Dafür suchen wir Sie: neugierig, technisch versiert und mit Freude daran, aus guten Ideen hilfreiche KI-Anwendungen zu entwickeln – gerne auch vollständig remote. Ihre Aufgaben Sie konzipieren, entwickeln und optimieren KI-Agenten und spezialisierte Skills für interne Arbeitsabläufe. Sie übersetzen Anforderungen aus der Steuerberatung , Wirtschaftsprüfung und Unternehmensberatung in klare und robuste KI-Workflows. Sie formulieren und optimieren Prompts , Entscheidungslogiken und strukturierte Fragebögen . Sie testen Ergebnisse systematisch, erkennen Fehlerbilder und entwickeln unsere Qualitätsstandards weiter. Sie unterstützen bei der Anbindung und Nutzung von Datenquellen und Tools , beispielsweise DATEV-Exporte, Tabellen, Dokumente oder interne Wissensbestände. Sie dokumentieren Lösungen verständlich und sorgen dafür, dass Kolleginnen und Kollegen diese sicher anwenden können. Sie verfolgen neue Entwicklungen rund um KI-Agenten , Large Language Models und Automatisierung und bringen geeignete Ideen pragmatisch in die Umsetzung. Für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung Ihrer Ideen erhalten Sie Zugriff auf gängige KI- und Coding-Tools wie Claude und Codex. Ihr Profil Sie studieren Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Betriebswirtschaftslehre mit Digital- oder Technologieschwerpunkt oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang. Sie verfügen über ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für künstliche Intelligenz, insbesondere für Large Language Models, Prompt Engineering oder agentische Workflows. Idealerweise bringen Sie erste praktische Erfahrungen mit Python, APIs, Datenaufbereitung, Automatisierung oder Vibe Coding mit. Sie arbeiten strukturiert, denken analytisch und geben sich nicht mit einer Antwort zufrieden, nur weil diese überzeugend klingt. Sie können komplexe Themen verständlich erklären und arbeiten gerne mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen zusammen. Vorkenntnisse in der Steuerberatung, im Rechnungswesen oder im Umgang mit DATEV sind willkommen, aber kein Muss – Ihr Interesse und Ihre Lernbereitschaft zählen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden Ihr Profil ab. Warum wir? Flexibel bleiben: Arbeitszeiten, die zu Studium, Alltag und Leben passen. Weiterkommen: Fort- und Weiterbildungen, die zu Ihren Stärken und Zielen passen. Gesehen werden: Ihr Einsatz zählt – und wird wertgeschätzt. Ideen einbringen: Kurze Wege, offene Türen und Raum für Ihre Perspektive. Sicher starten: HWS gibt es seit 1923 – und trotzdem schauen wir nach vorn. Modern & zukunftsorientiert: Digitale Prozesse und gezielter Einsatz von KI für mehr Raum für wirklich wichtige Aufgaben. International vernetzt, fachlich stark: Internationales Partner- und Expertennetzwerk für vielfältige fachliche Perspektiven. Einfach ausgezeichnet: HWS ist als Arbeitgeber mehrfach ausgezeichnet – unter anderem mit dem TOP JOB Award 2026 . Mehr für Sie: Moderne Arbeitsplätze, Rabatte für Mitarbeitende und Angebote rund um Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden. Echt im Team: Menschen, die zusammenhalten, sich unterstützen und den HWS-Spirit leben. Ansprechpartner Frau Beatrix Dreher HWS GmbH & Co. title: Masseur / Physiotherapeuth (m/w/d) - Deimann Spa
description: Wenn ein Gast nach einer Behandlung tiefenentspannt den Deimann Spa verlässt, ist genau das der Moment, in dem Ihre Arbeit spürbar wird. Mit fachlichem Können, Ruhe und einem sicheren Gespür für die individuellen Bedürfnisse unserer Gäste machen Sie aus einer Massage oder Wellnessanwendung eine wertvolle Auszeit. Im Deimann Spa, dem Wellnessbereich unseres 5-Sterne-Superior-Hotels im Sauerland, verbinden wir professionelle Anwendungen mit herzlicher persönlicher Betreuung. Sie arbeiten in einem hochwertigen Umfeld, in dem Qualität nicht nur bei der Behandlung zählt, sondern auch in jedem Kontakt mit unseren Gästen. Aufgaben Führen Sie klassische und wellnessorientierte Massageanwendungen professionell und mit einem sicheren Gespür für die individuellen Bedürfnisse unserer Gäste durch. Setzen Sie Ihr fachliches Wissen bei physiotherapeutischen Anwendungen ein, sofern diese Ihrer Qualifikation entsprechen, und begleiten Sie unsere Gäste verantwortungsvoll auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Wohlbefinden. Beraten Sie unsere Gäste individuell zu passenden Massage- und Wellnessanwendungen und finden Sie gemeinsam mit ihnen die Behandlung, die zu ihren persönlichen Bedürfnissen passt. Erkennen Sie im Rahmen Ihrer fachlichen Qualifikation die individuellen Bedürfnisse unserer Gäste und stimmen Sie Ihre Behandlung entsprechend darauf ab. Betreuen Sie unsere Gäste während ihres gesamten Aufenthalts im Deimann Spa aufmerksam, herzlich und professionell. Bereiten Sie die Behandlungsräume sorgfältig vor und nach, damit jede Anwendung in einer ruhigen, gepflegten und hochwertigen Atmosphäre stattfinden kann. Sichern Sie durch Ihre sorgfältige Arbeitsweise die hohen Hygiene- und Qualitätsstandards unseres Spa-Bereichs. Arbeiten Sie eng mit Ihrem Spa-Team zusammen und tragen Sie dazu bei, dass unsere Gäste fachlich kompetent und persönlich aufmerksam betreut werden. Gestalten Sie mit Ihrer Arbeit ein Spa-Erlebnis, das unseren Gästen Ruhe, Entspannung und die besondere Qualität des Hotel Deimann vermittelt. Arbeiten Sie überwiegend tagsüber bis in die Abendstunden, regulär bis etwa 19:00 Uhr. Auch Sonn- und Feiertage gehören zu Ihrem Arbeitsalltag. Qualifikation Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Masseur/in, Physiotherapeut/in oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, damit Sie unsere Gäste fachlich kompetent und verantwortungsvoll behandeln können. Sie bringen idealerweise praktische Erfahrung in Massage, Physiotherapie, Wellness oder einem Spa mit – aber auch als Berufseinsteiger/in sind Sie willkommen, wenn Ihre fachliche Qualifikation und Ihre Haltung zu uns passen. Sie verfügen über fachliche Kompetenz und arbeiten sorgfältig, weil hochwertige Massage- und Wellnessanwendungen ein hohes Maß an Verantwortung und Präzision erfordern. Sie haben Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Menschen, weil eine gute Spa-Behandlung nicht nur von der richtigen Technik, sondern ebenso von Aufmerksamkeit und Einfühlungsvermögen lebt. Sie arbeiten serviceorientiert und aufmerksam, damit sich unsere Gäste während ihrer gesamten Behandlung persönlich wahrgenommen und bestens aufgehoben fühlen. Sie treten gepflegt und professionell auf, weil Ihr persönliches Auftreten wesentlich zur hochwertigen Atmosphäre im Deimann Spa beiträgt. Sie arbeiten selbstständig, zuverlässig und verantwortungsbewusst, damit sich unsere Gäste jederzeit auf Ihre fachliche und persönliche Betreuung verlassen können. Sie sind ein Teamplayer und unterstützen Ihre Kolleginnen und Kollegen, weil ein außergewöhnliches Spa-Erlebnis nur gemeinsam entstehen kann. Sie bringen Flexibilität und Bereitschaft zur Arbeit an Sonn- und Feiertagen mit, da unser Spa auch an diesen Tagen für unsere Gäste geöffnet ist. Sie verfügen über gute Deutschkenntnisse, damit Sie unsere Gäste sicher, aufmerksam und persönlich beraten und betreuen können. title: Senior Threat Intelligence Consultant (m/w/d)
description: It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks! This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents. All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS! Tasks As a Senior Threat Intelligence Consultant (m/w/d) located in Germany, you will be a key contributor within NVISO’s Threat Intelligence (TI) team, working closely with colleagues across our DACH and international teams to deliver high-quality threat intelligence services to our clients and to support other teams across the organization. Your work will help organizations better understand their threat landscape, anticipate emerging threats, and respond effectively to real-world adversary activity. You will contribute across a broad range of threat intelligence activities, including strategic and operational intelligence, sector-specific threat landscapes, and continuous monitoring of open, deep, and dark web sources. Your intelligence will support not only incident response engagements, but also other NVISO services such as Managed Detection & Response (MDR) and Red Team operations, enabling detection, response, and adversary simulation activities with relevant and timely intelligence. You will also contribute to intelligence-led security assessments such as TIBER-EU and TLPT, collaborating with experienced team members to develop realistic threat scenarios and actionable intelligence. Working in a highly collaborative environment, you will focus on delivering accurate, relevant, and well-communicated intelligence outputs, while actively sharing knowledge and contributing to the continuous improvement of our services and ways of working. Contribute to the delivery of high-quality threat intelligence services across strategic, operational, and tactical use cases. Produce threat intelligence deliverables such as threat landscapes, adversary and campaign analysis, and sector-specific intelligence reports. Perform continuous monitoring of open, deep, and dark web sources to identify relevant threats, exposures, and emerging risks. Provide actionable threat intelligence in support of incident response engagements, helping to contextualize attacks and inform response decisions. Support other NVISO teams such as MDR and Red Team by delivering intelligence that informs detection engineering, threat hunting, and adversary emulation activities. Contribute to intelligence-led security assessments (e.g. TIBER-EU, TLPT), supporting threat research, scenario development, and reporting. Support capability-building engagements such as TI maturity assessments, operating model design, and intelligence process implementation. Participate in client-facing meetings and briefings, clearly communicating intelligence findings and insights. Collaborate closely with team members to ensure consistency, quality, and continuous improvement of threat intelligence deliverables and processes. Requirements You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states or the Austrian citizenship; 2–5 years of professional experience, including 1–3 years in cyber threat intelligence or a closely related cybersecurity role. Hands-on experience contributing to strategic, operational, or tactical threat intelligence use cases. Exposure to intelligence-led assessments such as TIBER-EU, TLPT, or comparable frameworks is a plus. Solid understanding of threat actors, attacker tradecraft, and intelligence frameworks (e.g. MITRE ATT&CK), as well as the intelligence lifecycle. Experience with open-source, deep, and dark web research and monitoring techniques. Ability to work independently on defined tasks and collaborate effectively within a team on larger engagements. Strong analytical and writing skills, with the ability to produce clear, structured, and high-quality intelligence deliverables. Effective communication and interpersonal skills to work collaboratively with clients and cross-functional internal teams. Up-to-date knowledge of current cyber threats, attacker TTPs, and emerging trends. Language: German and English at C1+ proficiency for client-facing work across DACH. Your availability Standard business hours with occasional flexibility required during active client engagements and incident response support. Travel Some limited travel within DE/AT/CH (~10%) for onsite engagements, workshops, and stakeholder meetings Benefits At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components: Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc); An entrepreneurial and agile company, where you will be stimulated and supported in driving new initiatives (either through internal innovation or by improving our service offering), without losing sight of having fun! Our commitment to coach and counsel you and help you grow; each employee receives a personal coach within the team, whose role is to ensure your well-being and helps you grow in your career! Regular team-building and fun events; A training budget of 10,000 EUR plus 10 days paid time off rolling over two years; An annual gross base salary between 69.000 EUR and 87.228 EUR, depending on your experience; Flexible working hours and home office possibilities (incl. working abroad options within the EU); Reimbursement of Deutschlandticket + BahnCard 50 1st Class; Business Bike Leasing; Company Pension Scheme; 30 holidays. title: Senior Consulting Engineer
description: <h3>The team</h3> <p>MongoDB's Application Modernization Platform (AMP) organization is the front door of our modernization business. In our Data Migration practice we move production data - safely, repeatably, at enterprise scale - from relational estates (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and from NoSQL platforms (Apache Cassandra, Azure Cosmos DB, Amazon DocumentDB) onto MongoDB. We do this both as standalone migration programmes and as the data workstream inside larger application-modernization engagements, using MongoDB's own tooling - Relational Migrator, Cluster-to-Cluster Sync, Atlas Stream Processing - alongside the open-source and cloud-native pipeline ecosystem.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our mission is to help our customers be successful by leading end-to-end their journey to MongoDB. In an era where AI agents handle routine migration mechanics - such as workload assessments, schema and query translations, and large-scale validation - our consultants focus on the high-judgment decisions that directly mitigate risk. Joining us now means helping draft the playbooks while they are actively being defined. We are seeking builders who prefer creating new frameworks over following legacy instructions.</p> <p>This role will be based remotely in Germany.</p> <h3>Position expectations</h3> <p>Delivery</p> <ul> <li>Plan and lead the technical delivery of data migration engagements end to end: source estate assessment, migration strategy and wave planning, schema and data-model transformation, pipeline build, validation, and production cutover with minimal downtime</li> <li>Design and operate change data capture (CDC) pipelines for zero and near-zero-downtime migrations - using Kafka and the connector ecosystem, Debezium and comparable log-based CDC tooling, and cloud-native replication services</li> <li>Bring genuine platform depth on the estates our customers are leaving: Cassandra data modeling and anti-patterns, Cosmos DB (Core and Mongo API) partitioning and RU economics, DocumentDB's compatibility surface - and use it to de-risk what the customer cannot see coming</li> <li>Work shoulder to shoulder with enterprise customers - architects, DBAs, platform teams and executives - from whiteboard to war room</li> <li>Own the full consulting lifecycle for your engagements, from planning and agenda-setting through post-engagement follow-up, surfacing risks and further opportunities back to Sales and Professional Services</li> </ul> <p>Pre-sales and growth</p> <ul> <li>Partner with Solutions Architects, Engagement Managers and account teams to scope and size migration opportunities, shape statements of work and estimation models, and give sales well-founded confidence in what is achievable and what it will take</li> <li>Cultivate your reputation as a migrations SME and trusted advisor, internally and in the market, and positively influence your own utilization through proactive customer engagement</li> <li>Identify services opportunities in our customers, new workloads or estates to be migrated or product improvements the customer could benefit from</li> </ul> <p>Building the practice</p> <ul> <li>Build and harden the AI tooling that makes migrations faster and safer: agents for automated estate assessment, schema and data-model conversion, query and code translation, and large-scale data validation - and fold what works into the standard delivery methodology</li> <li>Turn field experience into reusable assets: migration playbooks, reference architectures, estimation models, tooling improvements and enablement for the wider team</li> <li>Partner with Product and Engineering to bring field reality into MongoDB's product and migration-tooling roadmap</li> </ul> <h3>Candidate profile</h3> <ul> <li>Excellent analytical, diagnostic and problem-solving skills, and the composure to apply them during a production cutover</li> <li>Degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field, and a technology-first mindset that lets you build credibility with some of the smartest technologists in the world</li> <li>5+ years in software engineering, data engineering, or consulting delivery roles centred on data platforms and data movement at production scale</li> <li>Hands-on experience with at least one of: Apache Cassandra, Azure Cosmos DB, Amazon DocumentDB, or another distributed NoSQL platform - deep enough to reason about data models, consistency, partitioning and failure modes, not just operate one</li> <li>Real-world CDC and streaming-pipeline experience: Kafka or Confluent Platform, connectors, Debezium or equivalent, schema evolution, exactly-once versus at-least-once trade-offs, backfill-plus-tail patterns</li> <li>Solid grounding in relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL or MySQL) and in getting data out of them without breaking the business</li> <li>Competence in at least one programming language (Java, Python, Node.js, C#, Go or similar) - enough to build pipeline glue, validation harnesses and tooling, not only to configure products</li> <li>Working fluency with AI in real engineering workflows</li> <li>Excellent customer interaction and presentation skills: you can explain a partitioning strategy to a DBA at 10:00 and a migration risk profile to a Senior Leadership at 11:00, and both leave more confident than they arrived</li> <li>An entrepreneurial bias.   • Entwickeln und konstruieren von Kontaktteilen, Terminals und vergleichbaren metallischen Komponenten für elektrische Steckverbindungen
  • Definieren technischer Anforderungen und Abstimmung der Lösungen mit Kunden, Lieferanten und internen Fachbereichen
  • Entwickeln und bewerten von Bauteilgeometrien und Konzepten unter Berücksichtigung von Kontaktierung, Funktion, Toleranzen, Material und Fertigbarkeit
  • Begleiten der Konstruktion von der Konzeptphase über Muster und Erprobung bis zur Serienreife
  • Bewerten bestehender und neuer Designlösungen sowie Durchführen bzw. Begleiten von Machbarkeits-, Toleranz- und Designanalysen
  • Koordinieren und Bewerten von Messungen, Versuchen und Funktionsprüfungen sowie Ableiten notwendiger Optimierungen
  • Erstellen und Pflegen von 3D-Modellen, technischen Zeichnungen und konstruktionsbegleitenden Unterlagen einschließlich Änderungs- und Freigabeprozessen

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes technisches Studium, z. B. Maschinenbau, Mechatronik oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Konstruktion bzw. im Design Engineering im Bereich elektrischer Kontakte, Terminals, Steckverbinder oder vergleichbarer Präzisions-Stanzteile
  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Konstruktion von metallischen Kontakt- und Verbindungselementen
  • Alternativ: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Stanzteilen oder Stanzwerkzeugen, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt auf Terminal Design für elektrische Steckverbindungen
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in einem gängigen 3D-CAD-System, idealerweise CATIA V5
  • Erfahrung in der Auslegung von Bauteilen hinsichtlich elektrischer Kontaktierung, mechanischer Funktion, Toleranzen und Fertigbarkeit

  • Analytische, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Gute Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern

Benefits

  • Langfristige Perspektiven in einem nachhaltig-wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen
  • Zusätzliche Vorteile: flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein Gleitzeitkonto, Kantine, Parkmöglichkeiten am Standort, Getränke und weitere Vergünstigungen für u.a. Fitnessstudio, etc

description: Campact e.V. sucht eine*n  Systemadministrator*in – IT Security & Endpoint Management zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt mit 39 Wochenstunden im Homeoffice (deutschlandweit) befristet auf 2 Jahre Campact e.V ist eine Kampagnen-Organisation, mit der über 4,5 Millionen Menschen entschlossen für progressive Politik eintreten und unsere Demokratie verteidigen. Wenn wichtige politische Entscheidungen anstehen, starten wir Kampagnen – digital und auf der Straße. Wir schmieden breite Bündnisse und mobilisieren eine starke Bewegung für die gemeinsame Sache. Unsere Kampagnen treiben den ökosozialen Fortschritt voran und verteidigen unsere Demokratie. Damit eine gerechte Gesellschaft entsteht, in der alle Menschen sicher und selbstbestimmt in Frieden und Freiheit leben können. Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir eine*n Systemadministrator*in – IT Security & Endpoint Management zur Verstärkung unseres aktuell dreiköpfigen Anwender*innen Support Teams. Campact setzt als moderner Arbeitgeber auf Digitalisierung und Flexibilität – daher arbeiten unsere Mitarbeiter*innen fast ausschließlich im bezuschussten Homeoffice oder Co-Working-Space. Die Teamarbeit funktioniert über Mail, Chat, Video- und Telefonkonferenzen. Um unser gutes Teamgefühl zu fördern, ermöglichen wir regelmäßige persönliche Treffen und erwarten Reisebereitschaft für unsere Teamklausuren. Neben der Campact-Geschäftsstelle in Verden/Aller, die  teilweise als Anlaufpunkt dient, erwarten wir auch Reisebereitschaft, wenn Unterstützung vor Ort notwendig ist. Deine Aufgaben Mit Campact bewegen Menschen gemeinsam Politik. Mit Deiner Arbeit hältst Du dem Team den Rücken frei und unterstützt die Kolleg*innen bei technischen Herausforderungen. Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team unterstützt Du im Bereich Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit. Hierfür arbeitest Du eng mit den zuständigen Personen für Digital Security und Datenschutz zusammen.  Du nimmst einen aktiven Part im Incident Response ein, unterstützt bei der Nachbetrachtung von Sicherheitsvorfällen und bei der Umsetzung von Maßnahmen zur Risikominimierung (z.B. Phising/Schadsoftware/0-Days). Du unterstützt beim Risk Assessment und setzt Maßnahmen zur Risikoreduktion um und wirkst aktiv an der Erstellung und Pflege von Richtlinien, Prozessen und Dokumentationen im Bereich Informationssicherheit mit. Du bewertest neue und bestehende Anwendungen auf IT-Sicherheits- und Compliance Anforderungen und unterstützt bei der Integration in unser Mobile-Device-Management-System und betreust diese gemeinsam mit Deinem Team.  Du begleitest die Einführung neuer interne Dienste, kommunizierst mit internen wie externen Ansprechpartner*innen und betreust unsere bestehenden internen Systeme (wie IAM, Mail-Postfächer, Mailinglisten). Du kümmerst Dich um die Beschaffung und Einrichtung von Hardware (Notebooks, Tablets, Mobilfunkgeräte) und Software. Du unterstützt die User*innen bei alltäglichen Problemen mit Hard- und Software. Unser Angebot Du leistest einen direkten Beitrag zur positiven Veränderung von Politik und Gesellschaft, zu sozialer Gerechtigkeit, ökologischer Nachhaltigkeit, Toleranz und Gleichberechtigung. Du erhältst eine Vergütung in Anlehnung an die TVöD-Entgeltgruppe 10 und 31 Urlaubstage. Wir bieten Dir eine Vielzahl von attraktiven Sozialleistungen, u.a. monatliche Kinderzuschläge (bei Vollzeit z.B. 493,20 Euro für das 1. Kind). Durch eine Homeoffice-Pauschale bezuschussen wir die Ausstattung für eine gesunde und produktive Remote-Arbeit. In Hochphasen kommt es vor, dass Du auch mal an Wochenenden oder Abenden tätig oder rufbereit bist. Wir legen Wert darauf, dass Du Überstunden ausgleichen kannst und bezuschussen Wochenend- und Feiertagsarbeit. Die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben ist uns bei Campact e.V wichtig. Zusammen mit dem Betriebsrat haben wir eine Verteilungslogik erstellt, die es uns ermöglicht,  individuelle Bedürfnisse zu berücksichtigen und gleichzeitig umgehend und flexibel auf politische Ereignisse reagieren zu können.    Im Team arbeiten wir gemeinsam daran, langfristig erfolgreich und selbstwirksam zu bleiben. Dabei spannt sich der Bogen von einer transparenten Kommunikation über eine wertschätzende und offene Feedback- und Führungskultur hin zum Feiern unserer gemeinsamen Erfolge. Für Deine individuelle Gesundheit ermöglichen wir Dir Austauschmöglichkeiten mit Coaches und Psycholog*innen sowie eine vergünstigte Hansefit-Mitgliedschaft mit einer Vielzahl an Gesundheitsangeboten. Wir sind ein innovativer Arbeitgeber mit rund 150 netten Kolleg*innen und einer tollen Arbeitsatmosphäre – ob remote oder auf den regelmäßigen Teamevents. Wir setzen auf eine umfassende Einarbeitung, u.a. durch Pat*innen und ermöglichen Dir viele Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Campact e.V. ist eine NGO, die unabhängig von Politik und Wirtschaftsinteressen agiert, Transparenz wird bei uns großgeschrieben. ( Hier geht es zum aktuellen Transparenzbericht ). Unsere Profilbeschreibung enthält eine Vielzahl sehr unterschiedlicher Kompetenzen, die wir für diese Stelle relevant finden. Bitte bewirb Dich, auch wenn nicht alle Punkte auf Dich zutreffen – alles Weitere können wir im gemeinsamen Gespräch klären. Du hast eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung zum*r Fachinformatiker*in für Systemintegration mit 3-5 Jahre relevanter Berufserfahrung im genannten Aufgabengebiet oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Du hast (erste) Erfahrungen in einem Security Operations Center (SOC) sammeln können und der Umgang mit SIEM sowie IAM - Systemen sind Dir vertraut. Du erkennst automatisierungsfähige Prozesse und kannst diese mühelos als Python, Shell Skript oder Low-Code umsetzen. Du kennst macOS in- und auswendig und bringst idealerweise auch Erfahrung in der Betreuung von Windows- und Linux-Umgebungen mit. Du hast Erfahrung mit Mobil Device Management Systemen wie JAMF. Du arbeitest gerne mit Menschen zusammen und hast eine lösungsorientierte und empathische Arbeitsweise. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Deine Aufgaben, dabei sind Datenschutz und -sicherheit sind für Dich essentiell. Du hast bereits Erfahrungen in NGOs oder engagierst Dich in der Politik und kannst aus dem Umfeld eine Referenzperson für Dein politisches oder gesellschaftliches Engagement nennen. Du identifizierst Dich mit den Werten und der Arbeit von Campact. Hast Du Lust auf diese Herausforderung? Dann lade Deinen Lebenslauf ( ohne Foto , mit der Angabe Deines Pronomens, mit dem Du angesprochen werden möchtest, sowie der Angabe Deiner Referenzperson) in unser Bewerbungsmanagementsystem hoch. Statt eines Anschreibens beantworte folgende zwei Fragen kurz (maximal auf einer halben Seite): Warum bewirbst Du Dich auf diese Stelle? Wie kannst du zur Sicherheit unserer Organisation beitragen? Campact e.V. ist davon überzeugt, dass gesellschaftlicher Wandel nötig und möglich ist. Dabei müssen auch wir als Organisation uns weiterentwickeln – um uns noch besser für eine Welt engagieren zu können, in der alle Menschen ihre Freiheit gleichermaßen verwirklichen. Dazu braucht es auch Wandel in unserer personellen Aufstellung. Wir laden insbesondere Menschen mit Diskriminierungserfahrungen ein, sich bei uns zu bewerben. Der Prozess ist mehrstufig, beinhaltet eine Probeaufgabe, ein Gespräch mit Fach- und Personalkolleg*innen und ein Kennenlerngespräch mit der Teamleitung und der Geschäftsführung. Der gesamte Prozess soll bis Ende Oktober abgeschlossen sein. Weitere Informationen zu Campact e.V. findest Du auf www.campact.de . Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together. Hypergrowth Environment: If you're looking for greenfield, creative freedom, and real impact, you're in the right place. We're a team that is scaling fast - with purpose Great Workspace: A central office in the heart of Hamburg near the Alster, top equipment (MacBook), snacks, drinks, plenty of ahead products - and yes, a ping-pong table. title: (Junior) Organisationsentwickler:in für Zusammenarbeit & Lernen (d/m/w)
description: FÜR EIN NEUES GESELLSCHAFTLICHES ZUSAMMENWIRKEN: WERDE TEIL VON PROJECTTOGETHER Die Probleme von heute lassen sich nicht mit den Methoden von gestern lösen. Deshalb bringt ProjectTogether Menschen aus Gesellschaft, Politik und Wirtschaft ins gemeinsame Handeln. Wir nennen das Collective Action. Als pragmatische Idealist:innen denken wir das Neue und arbeiten im Jetzt. In unseren Missionen zeigen wir, wie ein anderes Miteinander zu besseren Ergebnissen führt: von Einzellösungen zu Allianzen, von Fragmentierung zu Koordinierung, von Misstrauen zu Vertrauen und von Anspruchshaltung zu Mitgestaltung. So bringen wir Hunderte Menschen aus verschiedenen Bereichen der Gesellschaft zusammen: von der Bürgermeisterin bis zum Aktivisten, von der Gründerin bis zum Staatssekretär, von der Familienunternehmerin bis zum regionalen Gestalter. Als gemeinnützige Organisation bauen wir breite Allianzen, die auf neue Art und Weise Lösungen entwickeln und umsetzen. Deine Rolle in unserem Team Als Teil unseres Kreises Human & Organisational Development (HOD) gestaltest und pflegst Du die Strukturen, Lernräume und Entwicklungsprozesse, die Menschen und Teams bei ProjectTogether dabei unterstützen, wirksam zu arbeiten und gemeinsam zu wachsen. Dabei bewegst Du Dich innerhalb eines klar gesetzten Rahmens: rollen- und spannungsbasiertes Arbeiten, der integrative Entscheidungsprozess und gewaltfreie Kommunikation bilden das Fundament unserer Zusammenarbeit und Organisation. Mit Deiner Arbeit sorgst Du dafür, dass wichtige Prozesse verlässlich laufen, Lernformate einen klaren roten Faden haben und Erkenntnisse nicht in einzelnen Meetings oder Dokumenten stecken bleiben. Gleichzeitig bist Du nah am Team und nimmst wahr, was gerade gebraucht wird: Wo entsteht eine Spannung? Was fehlt einem Team? Welcher Impuls sollte aufgegriffen werden? Und welches Format hilft wirklich weiter? Verantwortlichkeiten und Aufgaben Prinzipien unserer Zusammenarbeit: Du moderierst Rollen- und Spannungssessions sowie Retrospektiven. Darüber hinaus planst Du Trainings zu gewaltfreier Kommunikation und zur Übung von Entscheidungsprozessen. Lernen und Kompetenzentwicklung: Du planst und koordinierst praxisnahe Trainings und Lernformate entlang unseres Kompetenzportfolios zu wechselnden Themen. Lernkreise und deren Entwicklung: Du gestaltest teamübergreifende Lernformen, trainierst und begleitest andere Team- und Projektmanager:innen und stärkst sie als aktive Peer Group. Teamformate und Entwicklungsprozesse: Du koordinierst und entwickelst interne Formate wie Teamtage, All-Hands-Moderation und Teamumfragen sowie On- und Offboarding und unseren organisationsweiten Weiterentwicklungsprozess (Entfaltung) weiter. Außerdem sorgst Du für eine verlässliche Durchführung und Auswertung. Organisationsentwicklung und Zusammenarbeit: Du nimmst Bedürfnisse, Dynamiken und Spannungen in der Organisation wahr, greifst neue interne und externe Impulse auf und leitest gemeinsam mit den Leads des HOD-Kreises passende Veränderungen für unsere Zusammenarbeit, Prozesse und Formate ab. Wissensmanagement: Du sorgst dafür, dass Vorlagen, Prozesswissen, Lernerfahrungen und Entscheidungen verständlich dokumentiert, leicht auffindbar und für die tägliche Arbeit tatsächlich nutzbar sind – in Notion und in Lernformaten. Dein Profil Wir suchen eine Person, die verlässliche Struktur mit einem guten Gespür für Menschen und Organisationen verbindet. Auch wenn Du nicht alle Kriterien erfüllst, möchten wir Dich ausdrücklich ermutigen, Dich zu bewerben. Du hast mindestens drei Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Team- oder Projektmanagement, in der Organisationsentwicklung, im Bereich Learning & Development, in der Personalentwicklung, in der agilen Organisationsgestaltung oder in einem vergleichbaren Feld. Du hast bereits Erfahrungen in der systemischen Organisationsentwicklung, im systemischen oder integralen Coaching, in der Mediation oder in der gewaltfreien Kommunikation gesammelt. Diese Erfahrungen können aus einer Ausbildung, beruflichen Praxis oder eigenständigem Lernen stammen. Du kannst komplexe und parallel laufende Prozesse strukturieren, priorisieren und zuverlässig bis zum Abschluss begleiten. Du hast Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Moderation interaktiver Workshops, Trainings, Retrospektiven oder anderer Teamentwicklungsformate. Gleichzeitig bist Du nah am Team und nimmst wahr, was gerade gebraucht wird: Wo entsteht eine Spannung? Was fehlt einem Team? Welcher Impuls sollte aufgegriffen werden? Prinzipien unserer Zusammenarbeit: Du moderierst Rollen- und Spannungssessions sowie Retrospektiven. Darüber hinaus planst Du Trainings zu gewaltfreier Kommunikation und zur Übung von Entscheidungsprozessen.

Außerdem sorgst Du für eine verlässliche Durchführung und Auswertung.

title: Technical Product Owner (m/f/d)
description: About us Since 2000, ITA Logistics Group has been making shipping simpler, more transparent, and more efficient for businesses. With our platforms LetMeShip and ParcelParcel , companies can quickly compare and directly book their daily shipping needs. By bringing together a wide range of carriers on our platforms, we combine modern technology with personal service. Across several locations in Europe, our teams work every day to simplify shipping processes in a sustainable way. We believe in open collaboration and fast decision-making. That’s why we are looking for people who take ownership, contribute ideas, and want to actively shape the future with us. Your mission As our (Technical) Product Owner (m/f/d), you will be part of our Product Team and take ownership of key technical interfaces and integrations across our platforms. Your main focus will be on our Customer APIs, the Unified Carrier Interface (UCI), and, going forward, the Unified Financial Platform (UFP) as well as our HubSpot integration. You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and Business. You understand technical dependencies, translate different requirements into clear priorities, and work closely with our teams to ensure that our integrations are reliable and continuously evolving. You will collaborate closely with our Product Owners, Technical Business Analyst, Software Engineers, and Data Insights team while also acting as an important point of contact for internal stakeholders, customers, carriers, and external partners. Your Key Responsibilities You own and continuously develop the roadmap for our Customer APIs across LMS Enterprise and LMS Next. You drive the migration of our API customers from LMS Enterprise to LMS Next, identifying and prioritizing the features and carrier integrations required to make the transition successful. You act as a technical point of contact for our API customers, supporting them with questions, troubleshooting, and technical challenges. You take ownership of the development of our Unified Carrier Interface (UCI) in close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. You analyze requirements for carrier features and services, translate them into clear requirements for Engineering, and support QA in defining relevant test cases. You communicate directly with our carriers to clarify technical requirements and integration specifics. Once live, you take ownership of our Unified Financial Platform (UFP) and manage its backlog, requirements, and further development. You continuously monitor our existing HubSpot integration and prioritize adjustments based on evolving business needs and feedback. Across all these areas, you connect Engineering, business stakeholders, carriers, and external partners, ensuring clear requirements, priorities, and decisions. What you need to succeed You have a technical background, for example in Software Engineering or Computer Science, or several years of experience working at the intersection of Product and Engineering. You have experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally working with APIs, platforms, or technical integrations. You have a solid understanding of APIs, API design, versioning, and migration strategies and feel confident engaging in detailed technical discussions with engineers. You are able to understand complex technical topics and translate them clearly for different audiences. You are confident in stakeholder management and know how to balance and prioritize competing technical and business needs. You are comfortable managing multiple workstreams and adapting to changing priorities while keeping a clear overview of what matters most. You enjoy working collaboratively across teams and locations, including with colleagues in Hamburg and Naarden. You are curious about AI tools and digital solutions and enjoy exploring new ways to improve productivity, processes, and workflows. Experience in logistics, parcel, or freight tech, particularly with carrier API integrations, is a plus. Familiarity with HubSpot or CRM integrations, as well as financial or invoicing systems and interfaces, is also a plus. Across all these areas, you connect Engineering, business stakeholders, carriers, and external partners, ensuring clear requirements, priorities, and decisions. Why ITA Logistics Group? You can expect a work environment where new ideas are genuinely welcomed and feedback is not just accepted, but actively encouraged. We challenge the status quo, embrace agile ways of working, and continuously evolve. This also means making use of modern digital tools and AI-driven solutions that support your day-to-day work and help make processes more efficient. 30 days of vacation Flexible working hours and hybrid work Time tracking and overtime compensation Subsidized HVV/Deutschlandticket or parking SpenditCard with a monthly credit of €50 Company pension scheme Corporate Benefits Program Counseling and support services through the Fürstenberg Institute Workation opportunities Join the ITA Crew You feel addressed and are interested in joining our team as Technical Product Owner in beautiful Hamburg ? Please apply stating your earliest possible starting date! Franziska Linge i s looking forward to your application. title: New Business Account Executive (DACH market)
description: About The Role Vivid Money is redefining how modern corporates, holding structures, and financial institutions manage and optimize their capital. From institutional-grade Treasury products (high-yield Interest Accounts, Money Market Funds, and ETFs) to multi-currency infrastructure and FX solutions, we provide the financial architecture that traditional banks make too slow and expensive. We are expanding our institutional footprint in Germany. We aren’t looking for a standard software sales rep; we are looking for a New Business Account Executive who understands the fabric of the German financial ecosystem. You will be employee number one on the ground, tasked with unlocking high-value segments: PE/VC funds, holding companies (Soparfis), family offices, and corporate service providers. If you have the network to navigate corporate Germany, understand structured finance/treasury needs, and want the autonomy to build a market from scratch, this role is for you. Your Mission Originate Institutional Pipeline : Identify and engage decision-makers across Germanys unique B2B landscape, focusing on PE/VC funds, corporate holding structures, asset managers, and corporates. Leverage Channel Partnerships : Build strategic relationships with local multipliers—accountants, tax advisors, law firms—who manage hundreds of entities requiring modern treasury setups. Navigate Complex Sales Cycles : Run the end-to-end commercial cycle for high-value accounts, from sophisticated discovery and structured treasury pitches to compliance onboarding and closing. Position Vivid as a Yield Partner : Educate fund managers and corporate treasurers on how to leverage Vivid’s Treasury and MMF solutions to optimize returns on their cash reserves and dry powder. Shape the German Playbook : Partner directly with the Sales Leadership team to refine our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), localized messaging, and regulatory positioning for the German market. Represent the Brand : Act as the face of Vivid Money GmbH at major financial services, fund industry, and fintech events in Germany. Your Profile 5+ years of B2B/Institutional sales experience within the German financial ecosystem (e.g., Private Banking, Corporate Banking, Fund Services, FinTech, or Treasury/Asset Management). Deep local knowledge : You thoroughly understand Germanys financial structures (Soparfis, RAIFs, SICAVs) and know how these entities manage liquidity and banking relationships. An established network : You have an existing book of contacts or a proven ability to network into CFOs, Fund Operations leads, Managing Directors, and Domiciliation Agents. Technical fluency : You can speak confidently about FX, money market funds, yield generation, and compliance/KYB processes for complex corporate structures. Entrepreneurial mindset : You thrive in an "AI-first," high-autonomy environment where the playbook is yours to write. Languages : Full professional fluency in English and German is required. Why Join Vivid? Hybrid or remote way of work. You can work from our Berlin office or fully remote from other locations. Direct influence on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth. Significant ownership from day one and strong growth opportunities. AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it. Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. Fully paid vacation and sick leave. Sports compensation. Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one. Compensation range Total target compensation: from €120,000 gross annually (base salary + performance-related bonus). Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria. About Vivid At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights. Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality. Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started. We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. title: Senior Director, Global Power Origination & Market Development
description: <p>Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Senior Director of Global Power Origination &amp; Market Development to join our team.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Position Description</strong></p> <p>Oklo is seeking a highly strategic, commercially minded, and globally oriented leader to advance the international deployment of Oklo’s Aurora powerhouses. The Senior Director, International Aurora Deployment &amp; Market Development will combine the responsibilities of a business development lead and an international deployment project lead. This individual will identify and develop priority markets and prospective partners, own key external business relationships, and manage implementation of Oklo’s international deployment strategy across internal teams and outside advisors.</p> <p>The role sits at the intersection of international energy markets, power origination, project development, government engagement, commercial structuring, nuclear regulatory and export considerations, and cross-functional program leadership. The Senior Director will serve as the central coordinator for international Aurora deployment opportunities, ensuring that commercial discussions remain aligned with Oklo’s strategy and with relevant technical, legal, regulatory, security, safeguards, and government affairs requirements.</p> <p>This position is focused specifically on opportunities that support the deployment of Oklo’s Aurora reactors outside the United States.&nbsp;There will be significant international travel expected. We are only considering candidates based in the Netherlands or United Kingdom.</p> <p><strong>Specific responsibilities may include:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>International Deployment Leadership</strong> <ul> <li>Manage implementation of Oklo’s international deployment strategy and translate strategic priorities into coordinated market, partner, and project-development activities</li> <li>Serve as the central point of coordination across business, strategy, government affairs, legal, regulatory, reactor, fuel, security, safeguards, finance, supply chain, and communications teams, as well as outside consultants</li> <li>Develop integrated workplans, decision points, priorities, and next steps for international deployment opportunities and drive follow-through across responsible teams</li> <li>Ensure that external engagement, commercial discussions, and partner commitments remain aligned with company strategy and relevant technical, legal, regulatory, and policy milestones</li> <li>Provide executive leadership with clear recommendations on market prioritization, partner strategy, deployment barriers, risks, and resource needs<br><br></li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Business Development &amp; Partner Origination</strong> <ul> <li>Identify, evaluate, and develop international opportunities for deployment of Aurora powerhouses, including utility, industrial, data center, government, infrastructure, and other prospective customer or project-partner opportunities</li> <li>Develop and lead business relationships within Oklo’s overall international strategy and own the relationship with prospective deployment partners once established</li> <li>Lead partner discussions regarding power offtake, project development, supply chain, procurement, siting, localization, financing, commercial considerations, and general business strategy, supported by relevant internal subject-matter experts</li> <li>Work with legal and other internal teams to advance nondisclosure agreements, memorandums of understanding, cooperation agreements, development agreements, power purchase or energy supply frameworks, and other deployment-related arrangements</li> <li>Develop commercial structures that align Oklo’s build-own-operate model, or other approved international delivery models, with customer, government, and infrastructure partner objectives</li> <li>Coordinate and oversee business development consultants supporting priority international markets<br><br></li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Market Evaluation &amp; Deployment Strategy</strong> <ul> <li>Assess international electricity market dynamics, customer demand, industrial growth trends, energy security priorities, infrastructure needs, and policy environments to identify where Aurora deployment can create the greatest strategic and commercial value</li> <li>Evaluate how Aurora powerhouses can integrate into evolving power systems, industrial ecosystems, and critical infrastructure networks, including the commercial, technical, regulatory, and infrastructure conditions required for deployment</li> <li>Evaluate market structures, power pricing and procurement frameworks, regulatory pathways, siting considerations, grid conditions, fuel and supply chain constraints, and other deployment barriers across priority jurisdictions</li> <li>Develop market-entry and partner-engagement plans for priority countries and regions</li> <li>Assess potential deployment models, project sequencing, localization requirements, and scalable pathways from initial project development to broader market deployment</li> <li>Synthesize market, commercial, geopolitical, regulatory, and technical information into clear recommendations and decision materials for leadership<br><br></li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Government &amp; Institutional Engagement</strong> <ul> <li>Coordinate engagement on international Aurora deployment with relevant U.S. government and international stakeholders and serve as a primary point of contact, working closely with Government Affairs to maintain alignment</li> <li>Engage, as appropriate, with U.S. government organizations and agencies such as the Department of State, Department of Commerce, U.S. Trade and Development Agency, Department of Energy, National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA), and export credit agencies, as well as host-country ministries, regulators, and the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA)</li> <li>Identify and evaluate government-backed programs, public-private partnership opportunities, export support, grants, incentives, and infrastructure financing pathways that directly enable international Aurora deployment</li> <li>Monitor geopolitical, nuclear cooperation, industrial policy, energy security, and export-control developments that may affect market entry or project execution</li> <li>Coordinate with Government Affairs on U.S. government relationships, trade missions, and policy engagement supporting international deployment<br><br></li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Oversight</strong> <ul> <li>Coordinate technical subject-matter experts supporting questionnaires, partner diligence, meeting preparation, and discussions involving reactor technology, fuel, safety, security, safeguards, siting, operations, and project integration</li> <li>Coordinate with Government Affairs and technical subject-matter experts supporting safeguards and nonproliferation engagement with the IAEA, NNSA programs, national laboratories, and other relevant stakeholders</li> <li>Coordinate with legal and regulatory leads regarding licensing status, nuclear cooperation requirements, export controls and licensing, and other legal or regulatory matters relevant to international deployment</li> <li>Coordinate with supply chain, procurement, construction, and finance teams to assess project feasibility, localization, manufacturing, logistics, and commercial requirements</li> <li>Ensure questions and commitments are directed to the appropriate internal owner, tracked, resolved, and incorporated into partner engagement and project planning<br><br></li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>External Representation</strong> <ul> <li>Review international conferences, workshops, trade missions, and speaking opportunities against strategic priorities and recommend where Oklo should participate</li> <li>Represent Oklo at major international conferences, workshops, and partner meetings, alongside relevant Oklo leaders and subject-matter experts based on the topic and strategic objective</li> <li>Develop clear, accurate, and consistent external messaging regarding Oklo’s international deployment approach and coordinate review by relevant internal stakeholders</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>12+ years of experience across international energy markets, power origination, project or infrastructure development, strategic partnerships, utility or industrial energy procurement, government affairs, or related fields</li> <li>Demonstrated experience developing and owning complex business relationships and advancing opportunities from initial engagement through structured agreements or project development</li> <li>Experience leading cross-functional initiatives across commercial, technical, legal, regulatory, finance, policy, and executive stakeholders, including teams where direct reporting relationships may not exist</li> <li>Strong understanding of global power markets, electricity customers, infrastructure development, energy contracting, and project economics</li> <li>Familiarity with nuclear power and the ways nuclear project development differs from other energy infrastructure, including its licensing, safety, security, safeguards, fuel, export-control, long-term project-development, and government-to-government dimensions</li> <li>Ability to understand and communicate sufficiently complex technical and regulatory information while relying on and coordinating appropriate subject-matter experts</li> <li>Experience working across multiple jurisdictions and with government, utility, industrial, infrastructure, or financial stakeholders</li> <li>Strong commercial judgment, analytical ability, negotiation skills, executive presence, and written and verbal communication skills</li> <li>Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, establish priorities, and drive coordinated execution in a fast-paced environment</li> <li>Willingness and ability to travel internationally on a frequent basis</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in nuclear energy, major power generation, large infrastructure, data center power, industrial energy, or other highly regulated and capital-intensive sectors</li> <li>Experience with international project development, export credit or government-backed financing, public-private partnerships, or cross-border energy transactions</li> <li>Working familiarity with nuclear regulatory, export-control, safeguards, or government cooperation considerations relevant to international nuclear deployment</li> <li>Experience managing outside consultants and coordinating distributed, multidisciplinary teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>Competencies</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Director, Global Power Origination &amp; Market Development that is:</p> <ul> <li>Passionate about clean energy&nbsp;</li> <li>Passionate about making advanced fission a reality</li> <li>Willing and able to learn quickly</li> <li>Highly strategic and a forward-looking thinker</li> <li>An entrepreneurial mindset with comfort operating in ambiguity</li> <li>An exceptional communicator, negotiator, and has relationship-building skills</li> <li>Contains a strong executive presence and cross-functional leadership ability</li> <li>Aware of global perspectives with awareness of geopolitical and macroeconomic trends</li> <li>Passionate for building transformational infrastructure businesses</li> <li>Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us</li> <li>Willing to think differently and do things in new ways&nbsp;</li> <li>Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment</li> <li>Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before&nbsp;</li> <li>Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems</li> <li>An excellent writer who can write in modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!</li> <li>Able to communicate technical content and results verbally&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who you are:</strong></p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">A startup person</span>: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.</p> <p><u>Motivated</u>: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.</p> <p><u>A team-player</u>: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.</p> <p><u>An excellent communicator</u>: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.</p> <p><u>Creative</u>: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.</p> <p><u>Detail-oriented</u>: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About Oklo compensation:</strong></p> <p>Salary: $200,000-$265,000</p> <p>Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.</p> <hr> <p><strong>About Oklo Inc.:</strong> Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">#CHOP: Oklo’s Values</strong><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Collaboration</strong>: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.<br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Humility</strong>: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.<br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Ownership</strong>: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through&nbsp; to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.<br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Pathfinding</strong>: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.</span></p> <h3 data-start="82" data-end="118"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong data-start="86" data-end="118">Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer</strong></span></h3> <p data-start="120" data-end="326"><span style="font-size: 10pt;">Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. title: Senior GTM Systems AI and Automation Engineer
description: Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the Role: Camunda's Revenue Operations organization is looking for a Senior GTM Systems AI and Automation Engineer to design, build and operate the AI-powered infrastructure that connects our go-to-market systems and removes manual work across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships and Account Development. You will join the GTM Systems team – a small group of builders who own a Salesforce-centric revenue stack – and take ownership of its AI and automation layer: agents, LLM integrations, MCP servers, retrieval pipelines, backend services and workflow orchestration. You will partner with GTM leaders to find high-impact problems, scope them, and ship reliable, well-governed solutions iteratively. This is a fully remote role and can be based anywhere we are eligible to hire. What You Will Do: Design, build and operate AI agents, LLM integrations and automations that connect Salesforce, Gainsight, Slack, Salesloft, Clari, HubSpot, Impartner and the rest of the GTM stack – reducing manual work across Sales, CS, Marketing, Partners and ADR teams. Own the architecture of the GTM Systems AI layer: MCP servers, APIs, retrieval and context pipelines, reusable agent tools and skills, and serverless or containerized services on Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions). Ship production-grade LLM capabilities – prompt engineering, RAG, function calling, structured outputs, automated evaluations – with the guardrails to match: validation, fallback logic, confidence thresholds, human escalation paths, access controls, audit logging, and cost and latency management. Partner with Revenue Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships and SDR/ADR leaders to identify and prioritize automation opportunities, translate ambiguous requirements into maintainable solutions, and deliver incrementally with clear documentation. Raise the engineering bar for the GTM Systems team: code review, automated testing, CI/CD, security governance, observability and technical documentation; mentor teammates on responsible AI-assisted development. Design and deploy workflows on orchestration platforms such as Camunda and Clay, and create playbooks and enablement so GTM teams can use and operate automations independently. What You Will Bring to the Role: Must Haves: 5+ years of software engineering experience (backend development, systems integration, data or analytics engineering, or automation), including at least 2 years shipping LLM or AI capabilities into production business workflows or internal tools. Strong proficiency in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js), with mature Git-based development habits: code review, automated testing, CI/CD. Camunda's Revenue Operations organization is looking for a Senior GTM Systems AI and Automation Engineer to design, build and operate the AI-powered infrastructure that connects our go-to-market systems and removes manual work across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships and Account Development. You will join the GTM Systems team – a small group of builders who own a Salesforce-centric revenue stack – and take ownership of its AI and automation layer: agents, LLM integrations, MCP servers, retrieval pipelines, backend services and workflow orchestration. You will partner with GTM leaders to find high-impact problems, scope them, and ship reliable, well-governed solutions iteratively. This is a fully remote role and can be based anywhere we are eligible to hire.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build and operate AI agents, LLM integrations and automations that connect Salesforce, Gainsight, Slack, Salesloft, Clari, HubSpot, Impartner and the rest of the GTM stack – reducing manual work across Sales, CS, Marketing, Partners and ADR teams.

  • Own the architecture of the GTM Systems AI layer: MCP servers, APIs, retrieval and context pipelines, reusable agent tools and skills, and serverless or containerized services on Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions).

  • Ship production-grade LLM capabilities – prompt engineering, RAG, function calling, structured outputs, automated evaluations – with the guardrails to match: validation, fallback logic, confidence thresholds, human escalation paths, access controls, audit logging, and cost and latency management.

  • Partner with Revenue Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships and SDR/ADR leaders to identify and prioritize automation opportunities, translate ambiguous requirements into maintainable solutions, and deliver incrementally with clear documentation.

  • Design and deploy workflows on orchestration platforms such as Camunda and Clay, and create playbooks and enablement so GTM teams can use and operate automations independently.

Must Haves:

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience (backend development, systems integration, data or analytics engineering, or automation), including at least 2 years shipping LLM or AI capabilities into production business workflows or internal tools.

title: Senior sustainability advisor (engagement manager - jr. partner level)
description: About Watershed Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team. We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us! The role We are looking for an experienced sustainability professional to join our growing Sustainability Advisory team. The team serves as a strategic advisor to Watershed's customers , including more than 20% of the Fortune 500, helping them advance their corporate sustainability programs. Our primary areas of focus include: Decarbonization planning and execution across Scopes 1-3 Climate target setting, (e.g., SBTi-aligned targets) Voluntary and regulatory disclosures, (e.g., CSRD, UK SRS, CDP) Beyond customer engagements, the Sustainability Advisory team serves as a trusted internal source of expertise. We partner with the Product team to bring sustainability intelligence into the Watershed platform, and with the Go-to-Market team to strengthen Watershed’s expertise, differentiation, and thought leadership. In this role, you’ll be a highly trusted advisor to sustainability leaders at some of the world’s largest and most consequential companies. You’ll help shape sustainability strategies that make business sense, create the foundation for bold action, and advance progress on complex climate and environmental challenges. You’ll also help build the market-leading corporate sustainability platform by supporting teams across Watershed. This role is intended for candidates with experience at the Senior Manager or Engagement Manager level, or above, at a leading consulting firm. The scope, autonomy, business acumen, and sustainability expertise required are comparable to those expected at that level or above. You will Advise sustainability leaders at many of the world’s leading companies on advancing their sustainability programs. You’ll independently lead strategic engagements across target setting, decarbonization, environmental impact management, and voluntary and regulatory reporting. Working closely with customers, you’ll develop practical strategies and build the business case for sustainability throughout their journey. Build sustainability intelligence by staying ahead of emerging frameworks, regulations, and market developments. Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. We are looking for an experienced sustainability professional to join our growing Sustainability Advisory team. The team serves as a strategic advisor to Watershed's customers, including more than 20% of the Fortune 500, helping them advance their corporate sustainability programs.

You’ll help shape sustainability strategies that make business sense, create the foundation for bold action, and advance progress on complex climate and environmental challenges. This role is intended for candidates with experience at the Senior Manager or Engagement Manager level, or above, at a leading consulting firm. The scope, autonomy, business acumen, and sustainability expertise required are comparable to those expected at that level or above.

You will

  • Advise sustainability leaders at many of the world’s leading companies on advancing their sustainability programs.   • Help develop new products and services by exploring emerging sustainability needs across topics and industries. You’ll prototype new ways to create value for customers and expand Watershed’s impact at the intersection of sustainability, advisory, and technology.
