Hybrid in London or remote in the UK

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Credit Risk Modelling team.

You'll shape how iwoca models credit risk – setting the technical direction on multi-quarter projects, and lifting the bar for the team as you go.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Credit Risk Modelling team owns credit risk and Customer Lifetime Value (CLtV) modelling for iwoca's UK and German lending. That covers the probabilistic machine learning models behind every credit decision, plus the CLtV models that shape pricing and portfolio strategy.

The team is around twelve data scientists. Some work on auto-space models that decide within five minutes from data candidates authorise us to pull. Others work on manual-space models that pick up when a credit analyst adds digital footprint and income data, which lands a decision within 24 hours.

The role

You'll own credit and CLtV modelling projects end to end, from spotting where the modelling stack is holding the business back through to landing the change. The work spans keeping production models healthy, incremental development, and research that reshapes how the models work. AI has lowered the cost of prototyping enough that ideas which used to sit below the priority line are now viable, so the R&D share of the role is growing.

Live examples of the work:

  • Unifying auto and manual models. The two families were built without forced technical alignment. Finding a principled way to unify them on a common cost function is open work.

  • IFRS accounting model. A multi-stage credit model where information propagates back from later-stage recovery predictions to sharpen upfront loss estimates.

  • Generalising credit and CLtV. Whether a more general framing could replace both separate models is an open research question.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns.

  • Production ML. You have built and shipped supervised ML models end to end – exploration, training, deployment, monitoring.

  • Research mindset. You proactively explore new ways to add value. R&D time is when you expect to find the next step change.

  • Judgement. You critically evaluate model output – yours, a colleague's, or an LLM's – and can explain why a choice is right. You defend your reasoning under challenge, and challenge others' when the evidence points elsewhere. You've influenced technical direction beyond your own projects.

  • Project leadership. You've owned modelling projects end to end, from spotting the opportunity through framing, method choice, shipping, and landing the commercial impact. You move fast, iterate, and update on new evidence rather than chase perfection.

  • AI fluency. You use AI as a primary tool. You prototype with it, automate with it, and take on R&D that would not otherwise be viable. You use judgement on where it helps and where it doesn't.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Domain experience. You have worked in credit risk, lending, or customer lifetime value modelling.

  • Non-linear methods. You have shipped gradient boosting or neural networks on tabular data in production.

  • Bayesian methods. You have used hierarchical models, MCMC, or Bayesian updating in real work.

  • Time series modelling. You have modelled temporal data where autocorrelation, drift, or seasonality mattered.

  • Python. The stack the team uses.

The salary

We expect to pay from £90,000 – £120,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We’re looking for a Junior Technical Integration Manager in our Partnerships team (Hybrid in London, UK).

Partners send us thousands of small businesses each month looking for finance, using our Lending API embedded in the apps those businesses already use. You’ll be the person who makes those integrations work: guiding partners’ developers through the build, fixing what breaks, and turning what partners need — and what we learn from them — into what we build next. You don’t need to arrive with extensive experience of debugging API’s, but you do need to be curious and open to learning whatever it takes to help partners.

The team

The Partnerships team puts iwoca’s lending inside the platforms small businesses already use — banking apps, accounting software, payment providers and comparison sites— through our Lending API. Partners range from recognisable global names to one-person businesses, and each one needs its integration to work differently. The team’s job is to grow those partnerships and to keep the journey from a partner’s app to a funded loan as short as it can be. You will also work very closely with our Partner Flow team, who build and maintain the Lending API and any features partners need.

The role

You’ll be the main contact for partners’ developers, helping them with all things API. You’ll need to be curious, meticulous, and happy working under your own steam.

Mastery: become the person who knows the Lending API best

  • Learn the Lending API end to end — every endpoint, webhook and failure mode.

  • Guide a partner’s engineers from sandbox, to live and any ongoing optimisations. Shaping the integration they build along the way.

  • Review partner customer journeys and tell them what to change to get more businesses funded.

  • Triage live integration issues, trace them through the logs and code, and work with Partner Flow engineers on the fix.

Influence: turn what partners tell you into what we build

  • Own the technical relationship with each partner, from their engineers to their commercial leads.

  • Pitch new API features to partners alongside our commercial team, and make the case for why they’d move the numbers.

  • Be the partners’ voice inside iwoca — collect what they need and push it onto the roadmap.

Ownership: run the systems the whole partner channel depends on

  • Build the monitoring that tells us an integration is degrading before a partner has to tell us, then analyse and investigate what’s going wrong.

  • Dig into integration performance data to find the problems nobody has reported yet.

  • Own our public API documentation and make it the reason partners choose to build with us.

The requirements

Essential:

  • A degree in a technical or scientific subject — computer science, engineering, maths, physics or similar

  • An understanding and interest in how APIs work — enough to follow the logic in a partner’s integration.

  • Clear, concise communication with technical and non-technical audiences alike, and the credibility to manage a partner’s expectations.

  • An analytical approach that gets to the root of a problem, not just the symptom.

  • Commercial sense to judge which problems, and which partners, are worth your time first.

  • Comfortable using AI tools to investigate, analyse and get to answers faster.

Bonus:

  • Experience in a partner-facing or customer-facing technical role.

  • Experience reading API documentation or debugging an integration yourself, even on a side project.

  • Basic coding experience.

The salary

We expect to pay £32,500 - £37,500 (+20% quarterly OTE bonus) for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

 

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

As a Cyber Security Engineer I, you will act as the bridge between cyber security and emerging AI technologies. You will help shape how Checkout secures AI tools, models, data pipelines, and supporting infrastructure, while also identifying opportunities to use AI to strengthen cyber defence capabilities. Review AI use cases, architectures, and deployments to ensure alignment with cyber security policies, regulatory requirements, and internal governance expectations. Build and maintain monitoring, detection, and response capabilities for AI-related threats and misuse scenarios. Identify opportunities to use AI to enhance cyber security operations, such as alert triage, threat analysis, playbook automation, knowledge retrieval, and workflow optimisation. Stay current on evolving risks, attack techniques, regulations, and industry practices related to AI security and AI governance (inline with EU AI Act, ISO42001) What we’re looking for Experience in cyber security engineering, security architecture, or a related security role. Strong understanding of core security domains such as identity and access management, cloud security, application security, data protection, logging and monitoring, and incident response. Knowledge of AI/ML and LLM concepts, including model deployment patterns, APIs, embeddings, vector stores, prompt handling, and common AI security risks. Experience securing cloud environments and modern development workflows in platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Familiarity with security risks relevant to AI systems, including prompt injection, data exfiltration, insecure model access, supply chain risks, model poisoning, and sensitive data exposure. Ability to translate technical risk into clear, practical guidance for both engineering and non-technical stakeholders. Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work across cyber security, engineering, data, legal, and business teams. Trexo Robotics is enabling mobility by building powered wearable robots. Our first product is a robot for children with movement disorders such as Cerebral Palsy, and it allows kids to walk, in many cases, for the first time in their lives. The device is currently being used by hundreds of families and the best hospitals across North America.

We are constantly working towards building mobility solutions for all. At Trexo Robotics, you will find a flat organization where you can work with highly optimistic, low ego, and exceptionally talented individuals who look forward to solving hard problems.

About the job

We are growing our presence in the UK and are looking for a Clinical Specialist to join our team as our second UK-based hire. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for a clinician who is passionate about paediatric rehabilitation, technology and making a meaningful difference for children and their families.

As a Clinical Specialist, you will be a key point of contact for families, clinicians and healthcare partners using Trexo. You will lead customer onboarding and training, provide ongoing clinical and technical support, and deliver hands-on device trials at roadshows, conferences and other events.

The role involves significant travel, primarily across the UK and occasionally elsewhere in Europe. We expect travel to account for approx. 75% of your working time. You are practical and curious. You love asking 'why' multiple times until you understand something from first principles, and you thrive in unknown situations where you can apply logical reasoning, find solutions, and lead.

You will operate as a practical legal generalist with focus on:

  • Product advice covering Payward's growing offerings in the UK (Krak card, payments and staking, among other things)

  • Cryptoasset Regime Compliance (under the UK Cryptoasset Regime) — advising on regulatory obligations for CASPs including supporting on the steady flow of regulatory queries, notifications and supervisory correspondence that keeps our licensed entities compliant and our regulatory relationships strong; and

  • Payments & e-money compliance — advising on regulatory obligations affecting our e-money and payment accounts and supporting related workstreams as they arise

We're looking for a hands-on lawyer with strong regulatory fluency and a track record of independently owning BAU regulatory relationships (ideally honed in the regulated financial sector).

This is a fully remote role for a qualified lawyer in the UK

 

The opportunity

  • Provide legal support on cryptoasset, e-money and payment services regulatory requirements, including advising on account-access obligations and related operational compliance questions

  • Support the team's active licensing applications and other in-flight UK licensing or registration workstreams, including compiling application materials and coordinating with outside counsel

  • Provide regulatory support on corporate transactions and structural changes affecting UK entities (e.g., change-of-control notifications, corporate client migrations)

  • Support the day-to-day relationship with regulators for our licensed entities

  • Translate complex regulatory frameworks (e.g., the UK Cryptoasset Regime, FCA rulebooks, AML/CTF, operational resilience requirements (e.g., the FCA/PRA regime), outsourcing requirements, and e-money and payment services regulation) into pragmatic, actionable guidance for the business

  • Foster a culture of clarity, favouring plain-English communication, measurable risk tradeoffs, and decision-ready recommendations

 
 

What you bring

  • Qualified lawyer (Solicitor/Barrister of England & Wales, or equivalent)

  • 6+ years' post-qualification experience (PQE) in financial services regulatory law gained at a regulated financial services institution (e.g., a bank, payment institution, broker-dealer, exchange, or crypto services provider) or in a law firm/private practice supporting such clients, with demonstrated ability to independently own BAU regulatory workstreams

  • Direct experience supporting regulator engagement with the FCA (or equivalent regulator), including notifications, information requests, and supervisory correspondence

  • Substantive experience advising on the UK Cryptoasset Regime (i.e., FCA authorisation for regulated cryptoasset activities under the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (Cryptoassets) Regulations 2026)

  • Substantive experience with e-money and payment services regulation in the UK, including account-access and open banking obligations

  • Experience in AML/CTF (anti-money laundering / counter-terrorist financing), including advising on related policies, controls, and regulatory expectations

  • Experience advising on outsourcing arrangements and operational resilience compliance (e.g., the FCA/PRA operational resilience regime)

  • Outstanding analytical, drafting, and organisational skills with crisp, plain-English writing

  • Ability to efficiently and confidently distill complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-lawyer stakeholders

  • Pragmatic, commercially accountable approach to legal and regulatory risk that prioritises providing stakeholders with a useful range of options and clear recommendations

  • Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and owning a broad, fast-moving BAU workload from day one

 
 
 

Nice to haves

  • Familiarity with the UK's onshored MiFID regime (as retained and modified under UK law, originally derived from EU MiFID II) and its application to investment services, including derivatives, equities, and emerging tokenised financial instruments

  • Experience supporting change-of-control notifications or other regulatory aspects of corporate transactions

  • An authentic interest in crypto and digital assets, and familiarity with Payward's and competitors' products

against ambiguous requirements.</li> <li>Track record of being on-call for production services and contributing to operational excellence.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, title: Manager, Content Marketing, EMEA
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale. Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us. Attributes We Value We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles . You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor. You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next. About the team The Marketing team at Airwallex drives brand awareness and customer engagement through innovative and strategic campaigns. We work to communicate the value of our financial solutions, attract new customers, and strengthen relationships with existing ones. By leveraging data-driven insights and creative strategies, we ensure Airwallex stands out in a competitive market. Our team is passionate about telling the Airwallex story and supporting the company’s growth and success. What you’ll do You will own and scale Airwallex’s growth and demand generation content engine globally. You will work closely with global and regional teammates across Growth, Product Marketing, Product, SEO, Performance Marketing, and Lifecycle to build content that drives qualified demand, pipeline, and revenue. This role is ideal for a hands-on content leader who loves writing and editing SEO content, ebooks, guides, and one-pagers, and who is excited to go deep on technical product narratives—translating complex capabilities into clear, compelling, conversion-oriented content. You will join the Airwallex Marketing team during a critical period of growth. As we scale, we are building a team that balances global consistency in content strategy, quality, and process, with local flexibility and speed in execution. This is a unique opportunity to help shape how growth content drives the next phase of Airwallex’s expansion. This role is based in London. Responsibilities: Build Growth Content Marketing as a global discipline at Airwallex, establishing best practices, scalable processes, and a high-performing team over time. Own the end-to-end demand gen content strategy, spanning SEO, gated assets, mid-funnel conversion content, and product-led narratives. Write, edit, and ship high-impact content including: SEO pillar pages, cluster articles, and comparison content Ebooks, whitepapers, and long-form guides One-pagers, solution briefs, and product explainers Partner deeply with Product Marketing and Product to translate launches, features, APIs, and workflows into content that is searchable, understandable, and sellable. Use user, customer, and market insights to improve ICP targeting, segmentation, messaging, and content distribution strategies. Work closely with SEO and Performance Marketing to align content with keyword intent, funnel stages, and conversion goals. Be obsessive about measurement and iteration, using performance data to continuously optimize content for traffic quality, engagement, and pipeline impact. Hold a high bar for content quality and technical accuracy, ensuring clarity without oversimplifying complex concepts. Build a structured experimentation mindset—scaling what performs, refreshing or retiring what doesn’t. Balance short-term growth outcomes with longer-term investments in evergreen content, topical authority, and durable demand. Who you are We’re looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory. Minimum qualifications: 6+ years of experience in growth content marketing, demand gen content, or SEO-led content roles, preferably at a high-growth B2B technology company. A proven track record of creating content that drives measurable business outcomes across the funnel—from traffic to MQLs to pipeline. Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to explain technical products, platforms, or workflows clearly and credibly. Strong understanding of SEO fundamentals, including keyword intent, on-page optimization, internal linking, and content clustering. A data-driven mindset, with the ability to analyze content performance and optimize based on results—not just instincts. Experience partnering cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Product, SEO, Performance, and Lifecycle teams. Comfort working in a fast-paced, global environment and communicating progress and impact to key stakeholders. Experience managing freelancers or agencies and holding them to a high bar for quality and performance. Familiarity with common CMS, SEO, analytics, and experimentation tools (e.g., Webflow/WordPress, GSC, GA4, Ahrefs). Preferred qualifications: Experience in B2B, SaaS, or fintech environments. Additional language skills (e.g. French, Italian, Spanish, German, Hebrew,...). Good understanding of technical products. Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary. Equal opportunity Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

About the Role

You'll own a significant slice of the SINGU product suite: space management and Soft FM services – cleaning standards, portering, and catering – used every day primarily across the UK healthcare market. Product-market fit is established and thousands of users depend on these products daily. What the portfolio needs now is strategic direction and taking them to their next level of growth.

You'll do that through a team of four Product Managers who are domain experts in the products they run. This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll stay close to customer problems yourself, you'll raise the bar on how the team discovers and validates work, and you'll have real autonomy to decide what's worth building – and to prove it works.

SINGU group grows both organically and through acquisition, and several of these products arrived with the companies that built them. You'll shape the strategy for bringing them into one coherent ecosystem and lead your team through that change. If you enjoy taking a set of good but separate products and making them add up to something bigger, that is the interesting part of this job.

You'll partner closely with Sales, Engineering, and Product colleagues across the SINGU Group so your portfolio drives revenue and solves real problems across the European FM market. AI is a must-have lever in our industry rather than a talking point: you'll be applying it where it measurably improves how our customers run their estates.

This is a remote position with periodic travel to London and Kraków – roughly every two to four weeks.

Role Scope

People Leadership & Team Development:

  • Manage and develop the Product Managers within the product team.

  • Own the full management lifecycle: hiring, onboarding, mentorship, feedback, coaching, performance evaluations, promotions, and exits.

  • Foster a high-performing product culture based on customer empathy, data-driven decision-making, and outcome orientation.

  • Manage staffing and focus areas across the suite, reallocating product resources where needed to balance discovery workload and meet strategic priorities.

  • Lead the team through change – new ways of working, a shifting portfolio, and product consolidation – bringing people with you rather than around them.

Product Discovery & Strategy:

  • Define and maintain product roadmaps aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and market trends.

  • Decide where to invest and where to hold: set a clear, defensible position on which initiatives scale and communicate it across the business.

  • Build strong alignment with the Sales team to ensure product discovery and roadmap priorities actively unblock deals and support revenue growth.

  • Identify and resolve ambiguities, dependencies, and competing priorities that impact discovery quality and speed.

Product Management Best Practices & Standards:

  • Promote modern product practices, including continuous discovery, outcome-based roadmapping, and hypothesis-driven development.

  • Ensure product teams consistently validate assumptions through user research, experimentation, and data analysis.

  • Drive improvements in requirements quality, stakeholder communication, prioritization frameworks, and release planning.

  • Cooperate with the Chief Architect and Engineering Managers to ensure product decisions account for technical feasibility and platform constraints.

  • Drive the adoption of AI-powered tools and analytics to improve product insights, customer understanding, and decision-making quality.

Collaboration & Cross-Company Coordination:

  • Coordinate with commercial and customer-facing teams to align product strategy with go-to-market plans and revenue goals for the portfolio.

  • Represent the company at external events, conferences, and industry forums to share product insights, build the Group's profile, and stay connected to market trends.

  • Maintain alignment, knowledge sharing, and team cohesion with colleagues across the Group.

Experience & Requirements

Must have's:

  • 5+ years in product management, ideally with at least three of them in B2B SaaS. Strong B2C experience in FM, healthcare, or an adjacent domain is also worth a conversation.

  • At least two years leading a team as a people manager – product managers ideally, but we are flexible on the setup; what matters is that you have owned a team, not that you are ready to start.

  • Experience taking a team or a product area through real change: new ways of working, a restructure, or post-acquisition integration – and bringing the sceptics with you.

  • Demonstrable experience applying AI within product development, using AI-powered tooling to accelerate discovery and delivery.

  • Proven track record of leading product discovery across multiple methods and translating insights into validated roadmaps.

  • Strong commercial awareness: able to partner with Sales and align product decisions with revenue and retention goals.

  • Data fluency: comfortable defining metrics, querying product analytics, and using quantitative evidence to drive decisions.

  • Excellent stakeholder communication: able to frame trade-offs and build alignment across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • English at C1 or above, written and spoken, with the confidence to represent the product externally.

Nice to Have's:

  • Experience working in empowered product trios (or similar cross-functional squads) with engineering and design.

  • Experience in healthcare (ideally the UK market, NHS), public sector, or government-adjacent markets.

  • Familiarity with platform or multi-product portfolio environments.

  • Experience integrating acquired products into a single coherent platform.

  • Polish or German alongside English.

Not sure you tick every box? If you are strong on product leadership and craft but light on one of the requirements, we would still like to hear from you.

Why Here

  • Real ownership: you own a portfolio and the team that runs it. Strategy, discovery, and outcomes are yours, not a backlog handed down to you.

  • Modern product culture: we work in trios, practice continuous discovery, and ship to learn.

  • AI that makes sense: you'll apply AI to a platform customers already rely on, where it measurably improves how they run their estates – not bolted on for its own sake.

  • A stable base for ambitious work: SINGU is profitable and growing, with consistently stable results.

  • Growth: SINGU keeps growing through acquisition, so new areas to consolidate and lead keep appearing.

  • International scope: five companies and around 250 people across Poland, the UK, and Germany, with a portfolio that spans markets rather than one office.

If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.

description: <p><strong>Position Summary:</strong></p> <p>The Senior Manager, Clinical Operations – Clinical Process Owner is responsible for leading the governance, harmonization, and continuous improvement of Clinical Operations processes across the organization. The role owns the development, simplification, alignment, and lifecycle management of Clinical Operations SOPs, work instructions, tools, templates, and related process documentation. Working cross-functionally and across regions, the role ensures that processes are compliant, practical, scalable, and consistently applied. As a senior Clinical Operations SME, the role also supports audits, inspections, CAPAs, strategic initiatives, and business development activities where Clinical Operations process expertise is required. This is an individual contributor leadership role requiring influence across functions, regions, and seniority levels. The role may lead cross-functional working groups, process teams, and strategic improvement initiatives.</p> <p><strong>Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the Clinical Process Owner for Clinical Operations processes, ensuring effective governance, clear accountability, lifecycle management, and alignment across regions and functions.</li> <li>Lead the development, review, harmonization, implementation, and maintenance of Clinical Operations SOPs, work instructions, tools, templates, and related documentation.</li> <li>Identify and resolve process gaps, duplication, inconsistencies, conflicting requirements, and unnecessary complexity to establish clear, practical, and scalable ways of working.</li> <li>Translate regulatory requirements, ICH-GCP principles, quality standards, audit and inspection findings, CAPAs, operational data, and stakeholder feedback into effective process solutions.</li> <li>Lead and represent cross-functional process governance and decision-making, partnering with Clinical Operations, Quality Assurance, Regulatory, Project Management, Data Management, Biostatistics, Medical, Training, and other relevant functions.</li> <li>Lead process implementation and change management, including impact assessment, stakeholder engagement, training and communication requirements, adoption monitoring, and evaluation of process effectiveness.</li> <li>Act as a senior Clinical Operations SME for strategic initiatives, audits, inspections, CAPAs, process assessments, operational improvement activities, and business development support, as required, including including providing Clinical Operations input for proposals, budgets, contracts, and bid defense meetings, and representing Clinical Operations process capabilities, delivery models, and operational strengths to prospective clients.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p> <p><strong>Minimum Required:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, healthcare, clinical research, business, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.</li> <li>5+ years of cross-functional or global process improvement initiatives from assessment and design through implementation and effectiveness evaluation.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of clinical trial operations, clinical monitoring, site management, and cross-functional trial delivery processes.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory expectations, quality standards, and inspection readiness principles.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders, facilitate decisions, resolve conflicting requirements, and drive outcomes in a matrix organization.</li> </ul> description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About the AI Security Institute</h2> <p>The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.</p> <p>We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.</p></div><h2><span class="TextRun SCXW212922402 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW212922402 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">The deadline for applying to this role is 30</span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW212922402 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun Superscript CommentHighlightRest SCXW212922402 BCX8" data-fontsize="12" data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">th</span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW212922402 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun CommentHighlightRest SCXW212922402 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">&nbsp;September 2026</span><span class="NormalTextRun CommentHighlightPipeRest SCXW212922402 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">, end of day, anywhere on Earth.</span></span><span class="EOP Selected SCXW212922402 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;134245418&quot;:true,&quot;134245529&quot;:true,&quot;335557856&quot;:16777215,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0}">&nbsp;</span></h2> <h2>Team Description</h2> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Control measures — monitors, permission systems, sandboxing, resampling, escalation protocols — are designed to detect and prevent misaligned behaviour from advanced AI systems. Though the measures are already critical to safety, whether they would in fact catch a capable model attempting to cause harm is an empirical question that remains largely untested. </span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The Control Red Team at AISI is stress-testing control monitors (</span><a href="https://www.aisi.gov.uk/blog/how-our-new-control-red-team-is-stress-testing-frontier-monitors"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">including</span> <span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">from GDM and Anthropic</span></span></a><span data-contrast="auto">) – finding attacks that beat monitors and attempting to design experiments to measure real-world risk. We’re based within the Red Team, about a dozen people who have spent the last two years breaking developer’s alignment and misuse safeguards, and grew out of </span><a href="https://www.aisi.gov.uk/research?category_equal=%5B%22Control%22%5D"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">AISI’s</span> <span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">previ</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">o</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">us </span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">research</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink"> in</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">to</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink"> contro</span><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">l evaluations and safety cases.</span></span></a><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We're opening roles on the Control Red Team, and we think it's an unusually good place to do this work. You'd join early, with real ownership over the team's direction; you'd have frontier model access, serious compute and strong infrastructure support from across AISI; and you'd get privileged insight into control measures across several frontier developers, working alongside some of the most experienced red teamers in the field.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our current bet is to focus our effort on </span><strong><span data-contrast="auto">monitoring</span></strong><span data-contrast="auto">: the measures frontier companies lean on most heavily, and the ones where the science of evaluation is not yet settled.&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <h2><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">About the Role</span></h2> <h2><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">What You'll Be Doing</span></h2> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}"><span class="TextRun SCXW85424813 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW85424813 BCX8">You’ll</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW85424813 BCX8"> spend your time across two tracks of work:&nbsp;</span></span><span class="EOP Selected SCXW85424813 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></span></p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}"><strong><span class="TextRun SCXW56547643 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW56547643 BCX8">1. </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW56547643 BCX8">Research: </span><span class="NormalTextRun CommentStart SCXW56547643 BCX8">How and what should we measure to understand the efficacy of control measures? </span></span></strong><span class="EOP Selected SCXW56547643 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></span></p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}"><span class="EOP Selected SCXW56547643 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}"><span class="TextRun SCXW101216746 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW101216746 BCX8">How can we gather empirical evidence about how likely a monitor is to prevent harm — and what can we legitimately conclude from it? How do you estimate a monitor's recall against dangerous behaviours nobody has seen yet? These are </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW101216746 BCX8">difficult</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW101216746 BCX8"> questions</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW101216746 BCX8"> –</span> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW101216746 BCX8">conceptually and empirically. </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW101216746 BCX8">Day to day this looks like: designing and running ML experiments (including RL and other optimisation-heavy work), building the adversarial attacks that generate the evidence, writing arguments, and arguing them out with the rest of the team. raw.description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

Neko Health is looking for a Workday Integration Specialist to own the design, build, and maintenance of integrations between Workday and our wider systems landscape (TA, Reward, Payroll, Absence, Finance, and third-party tools). You'll work alongside the People Technology and module teams to keep data flowing accurately and securely across the platform and help extend Workday's capabilities beyond its native functionality.

What you'll do in the first 6-12 Months

  • Design, build, and support Workday integrations using EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, and Workday APIs (SOAP/REST)

  • Develop and maintain custom reports via RaaS (Report-as-a-Service) to serve downstream systems and stakeholders

  • Build and extend business processes using Workday Extend to digitise offline or manual processes

  • Troubleshoot integration failures, including security/permission issues, data mapping errors, and connectivity problems

  • Manage integration security: ISU setup, OAuth scopes, domain security policies, and API client configuration

  • Partner with module teams (HCM, Absence, Compensation) and system owners (Finance, IT, Workforce Management) to gather integration requirements

  • Maintain integration documentation, including field mappings and process flows

  • Support data migration validation and spot-check processes for ongoing data loads

  • Monitor integration health and proactively flag/resolve recurring errors

Minimum Requirements

  • Hands-on experience building Workday integrations using EIB, Connectors, and Studio

  • Working knowledge of Workday RaaS and calculated fields

  • Experience with Workday Extend (building or supporting custom applications)

  • Understanding of Workday security model (domains, business processes, ISUs, OAuth)

  • API integration experience (REST/SOAP), including troubleshooting auth and permission errors

  • Comfortable working across HR, Finance, and IT stakeholder groups

Nice to Have

  • Experience integrating Workday with ATS (e.g. Ashby), payroll (ADP), Microsoft Entra, benefits platforms (Thanksben)

  • Exposure to Workday Studio advanced transformations (XSLT)

  • Experience with data migration projects (e.g. legacy HRIS to Workday)

  • Workday Pro certification in Integrations or Extend

Why this Role

You'll join at a live, post-go-live stage of Workday's evolution at Neko Health, meaning your work has immediate visibility and impact, not years of legacy debt to untangle first.

title: Campaigns & Content Specialist
description: Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption. We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce. Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance. In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn. But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output. Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era. Once you're here, you will: Take full ownership of delivering campaigns end-to-end on a quarterly bases, from brief to delivery, working across channels like PR, social/digital, internal comms and events Turn a campaign brief into a project plan: scoping the work, setting the timeline, and identifying who needs to be involved and when Coordinate with external vendors and across internal teams that typically contribute to each campaign, keeping trackers current and hitting the date, flagging progress throughout and proactively spotting as well as solving blockers before they threaten timelines. Track and report on campaign and event performance against agreed success metrics, turning results into clear takeaways and recommendations for what to repeat or change next time Spot and flag blockers and risks early, before they threaten the timeline Produce first-draft copy, briefing docs and materials to a high standard, applying feedback so the same issue doesn't recur Use AI tools fluently - drafting, research, summarising, first-pass analysis - to work faster and enable creative execution, without compromising the quality bar Own the ad hoc execution of the comms team's recurring commitments, like all-hands and event logistics for one-off events, ensuring quality delivery and proposing suggestions that can drive efficiency in how we operate as a team. Work closely with leaders across Comms, Brand and Marketing, who will give you clear strategic direction and define quality About you: You have good judgement, strong organisational skills and creativity - you can turn a brief into a clear plan You're genuinely energised by the detail of delivery, not just the creative brief You're comfortable working across multiple channels: a PR background is not essential, a digital/social comms or events background works just as well - what matters is your judgement and creativity. You have a track record of coordinating cross-functional contributors to hit a deadline, even when they don't report to you You produce excellent first-draft work and take feedback well, applying it so the same note doesn't come up twice You are hungry to learn and develop from the Comms, Brand and Marketing leaders you’ll collaborate with closely You're fluent in AI tools and use them to move faster, while applying strong judgement to everything you ship You thrive in a networked organisation, building trust with people across teams who don't report to you Benefits Time off - 27 days holiday, plus 5 additional days off: 1 life event day, 2 volunteer days, 2 company-wide wellbeing days (M-Powered Weekend) and 8 bank holidays per year Health & Wellness - private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support Hybrid work offering - for most roles we collaborate in the office three days per week with the exception of Coaches and Instructors who collaborate in the office once a month Work-from-anywhere scheme - you'll have the opportunity to work from anywhere, up to 10 days per year Space to connect: Beyond the desk, we make time for weekly catch-ups, seasonal celebrations, and have a kitchen that’s always stocked! Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here . Our Commitment to Safeguarding Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy , our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS). For roles that will involve a Regulated Activity, successful applicants must also undergo an Enhanced DBS check, including a Children’s Barred List check and a Prohibition Order check. Roles involving Regulated Activity may interact with vulnerable groups, therefore are exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 meaning applicants are required to declare any convictions, cautions, reprimands, and final warnings. Providing false information is an offence and could result in the application being rejected or summary dismissal if the applicant has been selected, and possible referral to the police and the DBS. title: Senior UX Designer - Star Trek Fleet Command
description: <p>Scopely is looking for a <strong>Senior UX Designer</strong> to join our Star Trek Fleet Command team within our Live Games Portfolio division in the UK on a remote basis.</p> <p>At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.</p> <p>Star Trek Fleet Command is a standout success in the gaming industry. Launched in 2018, our in-house developed 4X Strategy MMO has continually evolved, earning its place as one of the top-grossing games on the market.</p> <h3>What You Will Do</h3> <ul> <li>Help shape the future of UX design on STFC, both through new features and through your own principles, practices, and standards.</li> <li>Own and deliver complete UX for new features and player experiences, turning ideas into fully developed designs that meet the experience targets of the product.</li> <li>Build deep knowledge of the game to effectively step into the player’s shoes and ground your design decisions in real player perspectives and experiences.</li> <li>Find relevant references and comps, deconstructing them to uncover inspiration and common pitfalls.</li> <li>Visualise ideas by producing a range of design deliverables that communicate your thinking and design intent. This includes sketches, low to medium fidelity wireframes, user flows, and interactive UX prototypes.</li> <li>Identify weak points in designs, gaps in thinking, and opportunities to better deliver on goals by applying critical thinking and a sharp design eye to strengthen solutions.</li> <li>Work closely with product teams, game designers and artists to refine ideas and stay aligned throughout development. Proactively share work, keep the right people informed, and provide relevant information when it’s needed.</li> <li>Leverage feedback, data, and other insights to refine designs—not just to react, but to reflect and make intentional improvements.</li> <li>Support long-term product and UX consistency through your design work by drawing on developed knowledge of our design principles and patterns.</li> </ul> <h3>What We're Looking For</h3> <ul> <li>Extensive experience specialising in game UX development, with a track record of delivering features or initiatives from concept to implementation.</li> <li>Confidence in navigating ambiguity, with the ability to identify next steps, recognise blockers, and take initiative to move work forward.</li> <li>A solutions-oriented mindset that goes beyond identifying problems, bringing thoughtful, creative problem solving to the table.</li> <li>A strong understanding of game development norms and pipelines, including how to design with technical constraints, implementation realities, and cross-discipline workflows in mind.</li> <li>A fit for a culture built on curiosity, improvement, creativity, and collaboration, paired with a genuine passion for both playing and making games that fuels thoughtful, player-centered design.</li> </ul> <p>Please ensure that the résumé/CV you attach is written in English.</p> <p>At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! &nbsp; We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us &amp; embrace the adventure!</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>About Scopely</h3> <p>Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.</p> <p>Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.</p> <p>Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.</p> <p>Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/">https://www.scopely.com/</a>.&nbsp;</p> <p>Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official <a href="http://scopely.com">website</a> and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @<a href="http://scopely.com">scopely.com</a>.</p> <p>Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact ----- Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-ca-residents">California Privacy Notice</a> and <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/eea-and-uk-job-applicant-privacy-notice">EEA/UK Privacy Notice</a>.</p> <p>Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <p><strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">About THG Ingenuity</span></strong></p> <p>THG Ingenuity is a fully integrated digital commerce ecosystem, designed to power brands without limits. Our global end-to-end tech platform is comprised of three products: THG Commerce, THG Studios, THG Fulfilment.&nbsp;</p> <p>Each represents a single, unified solution, overcoming challenges and taking brands direct-to-consumer. Our client portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Coca-Cola, Nestle, Elemis, Homebase, and Proctor &amp; Gamble.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 1">About the Role:</span></span></strong></p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">The Senior Ecommerce Manager is a senior commercial leadership role, responsible for setting and delivering the <strong>ecommerce trading, inventory and marketing strategy</strong> across a client account or vertical.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">This role goes beyond front-end ecommerce performance. You will take commercial ownership of how <strong>stock, product mix, margin, marketing investment and customer demand</strong> come together to drive sustainable growth.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You will lead the development of trading strategies aligned to buying cycles, product launches and inventory plans, ensuring that merchandising, marketing and operational teams are working towards a unified commercial objective.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll be responsible for understanding and influencing stock health, sell-through, stock cover, margin performance and product lifecycle, using this insight to shape promotional strategy, visual merchandising, marketing investment and customer acquisition activity.</p> <p>Acting as the bridge between the Ecommerce Manager layer and the Head of Ecommerce, you will provide strategic direction to your team while leading senior stakeholders across buying, merchandising, finance, marketing and operations. You will own the commercial narrative for your accounts and have the confidence to challenge decisions where stock, margin or customer demand are not aligned.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 1">Key Responsibilities:</span></span></strong></p> <p><em><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">Strategic Trading, Inventory &amp; Commercial Performance</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134245418&quot;:true,&quot;134245529&quot;:true,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:120}">&nbsp;</span></em></p> <ul> <li>Own the overall ecommerce trading strategy for your accounts, with responsibility for revenue, conversion, AOV, COS, ROAS, margin, sell-through, stock cover and inventory health.</li> <li>Develop trading strategies that are directly aligned to <strong>buying cycles, range plans, product launches, seasonal priorities and inventory positions</strong>.</li> <li>Take commercial ownership of stock performance, working with merchandising and finance teams to develop strategies for stock optimisation, clearance, markdowns and margin protection.</li> <li>Lead cross-functional alignment between ecommerce, merchandising, buying and operations to ensure a unified approach to achieving optimal stock levels and product mix.</li> <li>Monitor stock depth, width, availability, sell-through and aged inventory, identifying risks and opportunities and translating these into clear commercial actions.</li> <li>Use inventory insight to influence promotional strategy, product prioritisation, onsite visibility and marketing investment.</li> <li>Ensure the trading calendar reflects both customer demand and the commercial realities of the buying and inventory cycle.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to maximise full-price sales, improve sell-through and minimise aged or excess stock while protecting margin.</li> <li>Own the strategic approach to product lifecycle management, from launch and newness through to seasonal transitions, markdowns and end-of-life.</li> <li>Oversee site performance and customer journey optimisation, using data, customer behaviour and CRO insight to identify opportunities for sustainable growth.</li> <li>Lead competitor, pricing, promotional and market analysis to ensure clients remain commercially competitive.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">Merchandising, Product &amp; Visual Strategy</span></span></strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Develop the overarching digital product and merchandising strategy in partnership with buying and category leaders.</li> <li>Attend brand and product showcases to understand upcoming product ranges, key USPs, product features, seasonal stories and commercial priorities.</li> <li>Translate product showcase insights into clear digital product strategies, including taxonomy, categorisation, onsite hierarchy, visual storytelling and content requirements.</li> <li>Define visual merchandising direction for key launches, seasonal campaigns and commercial events, ensuring the site reflects stock and margin priorities.</li> <li>Work with buying and category teams to establish product priority lists and inventory depth targets for key trading periods.</li> <li>Ensure ecommerce plans are informed by range architecture, product availability and anticipated customer demand.</li> <li>Develop merchandising capability and processes within the wider ecommerce team, embedding best practice and consistent ways of working.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">Marketing &amp; Channel Leadership</span></span></strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Own the overarching multi-channel marketing strategy across SEO, PPC, Paid Social, CRM, Affiliates and Influencers.</li> <li>Lead channel strategy and investment decisions based on <strong>commercial performance, inventory health, margin and customer acquisition efficiency</strong>.</li> <li>Ensure marketing spend is dynamically aligned to product availability, stock depth, margin targets and strategic trading priorities.</li> <li>Use attribution modelling, customer data and channel performance insight to optimise budget allocation and improve CAC efficiency.</li> <li>Balance new customer acquisition with CLV, retention and profitability objectives.</li> <li>Identify where additional marketing investment can accelerate sell-through of priority or overstocked products without unnecessarily diluting margin.</li> <li>Challenge channel teams to demonstrate clear commercial contribution and ensure marketing activity supports the wider trading strategy.</li> <li>Develop sophisticated forecasts to inform channel budgets, sales targets and inventory-led trading decisions.</li> <li>Partner with creative, brand and data teams to ensure campaign execution reflects product priorities and commercial objectives.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">Returns &amp; Customer Insight</span></span></strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Take strategic ownership of returns performance, identifying trends, root causes and commercial impact.</li> <li>Partner with buying, category, customer service and operational teams to reduce avoidable returns and improve product performance.</li> <li>Use returns data, customer feedback and behavioural insight to influence product content, imagery, sizing information and onsite communication.</li> <li>Identify products or categories with high return rates and develop cross-functional action plans to improve customer understanding and reduce return-related costs.</li> <li>Incorporate customer and returns insight into broader product, merchandising and trading strategies.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">Buying, Merchandising &amp; Finance Partnership</span></span></strong></em></p> <ul> operations.</li> <li>Lead regular reviews of stock health, margin, sell-through and trading performance, ensuring risks are identified early and action plans are clearly owned.</li> </ul> strategic planning sessions, presenting performance, risks, opportunities and forward-looking recommendations.</li> <li>Confidently challenge clients and internal stakeholders where decisions may negatively impact stock health, margin or commercial performance.</li> <li>Balance client ambition with operational capacity and commercial reality.</li> <li>Ensure client priorities are translated into clear actions across internal ecommerce, merchandising, marketing and operational teams.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Team Leadership &amp; Capability Development</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Lead, manage and develop a team of Ecommerce Managers and Executives.</li> <li>Set clear expectations around trading, merchandising, commercial analysis and data-led decision making.</li> <li>Develop the team's capability across inventory-led trading, visual merchandising, product lifecycle management and commercial optimisation.</li> <li>Coach team members to understand the relationship between stock, margin, customer demand and marketing performance.</li> <li>Establish consistent processes and best practice across trading and merchandising activity.</li> <li>Identify capability gaps and lead projects to improve the team's overall commercial effectiveness.</li> <li>Create a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership &amp; Project Ownership</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Lead complex cross-functional projects spanning ecommerce, buying, merchandising, finance, marketing, logistics and operations.</li> <li>Champion a unified approach to stock, trading and commercial performance across all relevant departments.</li> <li>Own strategic initiatives from initial opportunity identification through to implementation, measurement and optimisation.</li> <li>Establish clear project governance, milestones, responsibilities and success measures.</li> <li>Ensure projects deliver measurable improvements in revenue, margin, stock efficiency, customer experience or operational performance.</li> <li>Share market insight, commercial best practice and strategic learnings across the wider ecommerce function.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 1">What We’re Looking For:</span></span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant senior ecommerce experience spanning <strong>commercial trading, merchandising and digital marketing</strong>, ideally within a retailer, DTC, agency or managed services environment.</li> <li>Proven experience managing <strong>inventory-led trading and stock performance</strong> within an ecommerce or retail environment.</li> <li>Strong understanding of stock cover, sell-through, inventory depth and width, product lifecycle, aged stock and stock optimisation.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience partnering with <strong>buying, merchandising/category and finance leaders</strong> to make commercial decisions.</li> profitability</strong>.</li> <li>Experience influencing product mix and inventory strategy based on customer demand, trading performance and commercial objectives.</li> <li>Strong understanding of visual merchandising and the ability to translate product and buying strategy into digital execution.</li> <li>Experience analysing returns data and implementing strategies to reduce return rates.</li> <li>Strong understanding of digital marketing channels including SEO, PPC, Paid Social, CRM, Affiliates and Influencers.</li> <li>Experience using attribution, customer and performance data to optimise marketing investment and improve CAC efficiency.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams across ecommerce, merchandising, buying, finance, marketing and operations.</li> <li>Strong project management experience, with demonstrable ownership of complex commercial initiatives from strategy through to delivery.</li> <li>Proven people leadership title: Staff / Principal Research Engineer, AI Safety, Technical Mitigations
description: <p><strong>Your Impact at LILA</strong></p> <p>We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to prepare for risks from scientific superintelligence. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a safety research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems.</p> <p>We’re seeking a Technical Mitigations Lead, to lead the build out of safety systems at Lila for the safe deployment of our scientific capabilities to the world. Given the novelty of Lila’s workflows, integrating frontier-class language models with narrow scientific tools and lab-based automation, this role will require the design and deployment of technical safeguards beyond the current state-of-the-art.</p> <p>We expect the person in this role to start off the initial mitigations build-out, and then slowly build a team to support this function.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Be Building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set the build and research strategy for Lila’s safety systems, across scientific data analysis and generation pipelines, safety post-training, refusal classifiers, automated safety-testing / red-teaming systems, and monitoring systems.</li> <li>Conduct initial safeguards experimentation and buildout for Lila’s specific scientific needs, and subsequently lead a small team to execute on the build and research agenda</li> <li>Lead safety systems research to iterate Lila’s systems beyond the state of the art, given the needs of technical safeguards for both in silico and lab-based scientific workflows.</li> <li>Partner closely with <ul> <li>Other members of the safety team, such as domain-specific experts (bio, chem, materials) and eval buildout teams, and</li> <li>Non-safety teams, such as core AI, lab automation, and product teams,</li> </ul> </li> <li>Contributing to broader, high-quality research efforts - as and when needed - for scientific capability evaluation and restriction.</li> <li>Contribute to external communications on Lila’s safety efforts.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Need to Succeed</strong></p> <ul> <li>Track record of building safety systems, classifiers, or conducting post-training for frontier-class problems - science, reasoning, programming, etc.</li> <li>4-6+ years working in technically engineering with ML systems.</li> <li>Experience building scalable, production systems, not just prototypes.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to set research directions for open problems in post-training, classifier buildouts, and other relevant systems.</li> <li>Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and concerns to non-expert audiences effectively.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in developing or applying ML to biological or physical sciences</li> <li>Experience in building safeguards for scientific risks for frontier models / narrow scientific tools.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to lead teams towards engineering goals</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.</p> <p><strong>U.S. Benefits.</strong> Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.</p> <p><strong>International Benefits.</strong> Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.</p></div><div class="title">Expected Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$224,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$336,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About LILA</strong></p> <p>Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI.
